verdict.rationale: Motion advertises a generic Zapier connection to "thousands of apps" and a public API for creating/managing tasks and projects, which could technically bridge bookings into Salesforce/HubSpot, but there is no direct, named Salesforce or HubSpot integration, no CRM-specific booking sync workflow, and no case study confirming end-to-end automated flow into a CRM. Missing for 10: native Salesforce/HubSpot connectors, documented booking-to-CRM sync examples, and independent confirmation that Zapier bridge actually works for this use case.
